    (∀ n : ℕ, FiniteDimensional ℂ ((HH_A1_A1g χ n : ModuleCat ℂ) : Type)) ∧
      ∀ n : ℕ,
        Module.finrank ℂ ((HH_A1_A1g χ n : ModuleCat ℂ) : Type) =
          if χ = 1 then
            if n = 0 then 1 else 0
